input.free_text_description: This system is an IoT platform that serves Operator, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for iot data processor, iot traffic data processor, traffic data. Secondary concerns include data analytics functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Operator, I want to view real-time device data and monitor system health, so that I can detect and respond to anomalies quickly.
As a Operator, I want to use iot data processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Operator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a User, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
